items.title: Redevelopment of Clayton J. Lloyd International Airport in Anguilla features CU Phosco high mast lighting
items.summary: CU Phosco supplied ICAO-compliant LED high-mast lighting for the redevelopment of Clayton J. Lloyd International Airport in Anguilla, improving visibility and safety across expanded aircraft stands and apron areas.

items.title: Casambi appoints Will Norris to lead North America
items.summary: Casambi, a wireless lighting control platform widely used in architectural projects, has appointed Will Norris to head its North American operations, a leadership change that may affect regional support and product roadmap for spec teams using the system.

items.title: Q2 2026 Acquisitions
items.summary: A quarterly summary of lighting industry mergers and acquisitions in the US, Canada and Europe, including Schreder's acquisitions of outdoor spec-grade LED maker NLS Lighting and solar lighting firm Photinus.

items.title: Messe Frankfurt acquires LiGHT Expo London
items.summary: Messe Frankfurt has acquired the LiGHT Expo London trade show from [d]arc media and will run it through its UK subsidiary, a shift affecting the industry's event calendar.
